svg.text: Proposed Surgical Tracking Stack — V-JEPA 2.1 + VGGT + GOT-JEPA + GOT-Edit + OccuSolver
Green = semantic • Cyan = geometric • Teal = visibility • Orange = predictor • Purple = editor/ReID
Infers: depth · camera pose · point maps
Freeze + light LoRA fine-tune on Cholec20
m = σ( Conv([v_sem ‖ Align(v_geo)]) ) z = m ⊙ v_sem + (1−m) ⊙ Align(v_geo)
Align(·): ConvNet to match semantic resolution (C×H×W)
Spatial gating — per-pixel choice between semantics and geometry
GOT-JEPA PREDICTOR TRAINING (Teacher–Student with frozen teacher)
Whiten z_sem → Z · M = ZZᵀ + λI
L_total = L_JEPA (pretrain) + L_det + λ_reid · L_reid + λ_wm · L_world + λ_occ · L_OccuSolver
